title: Module installed in the wrong slot
summary: Two modules were swapped or a module sits in a different slot than configured; the CPU reports a configuration difference.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Two modules were swapped or a module sits in a different slot than configured; the CPU reports a configuration difference.

troubleshooting.effect: Affected channels deliver no valid values or wrong signals
symptoms: Module status: configured differs from installed
Several inputs or outputs stop working at once
evidence: Hardware view: configured versus installed module per slot
diagnosticMethod: Compare the configuration with the physical rack
Check wiring follows the module (front connector)
repair: Move the module to the configured slot or correct the configuration
troubleshooting.explanation: The CPU checks each slot against the configuration; a mismatch keeps the module from exchanging data.
